scope: lm_qproj (1280->1280) and lm_gate (1280->6848) at their REAL model shapes
why: prior matmul_progcfg sweep tuned these at the unrepresentative fixture M=8; the real LM runs q_proj/gate_proj at prefill M=prompt_len (~277 for the standard demo) and decode M=1.
compute_kernel: HiFi4 / fp32_dest_acc=False / packer_l1_acc=False (MATCHES the model _lm_compute_kernel_config; out_subblock_h*out_subblock_w <= 4)
methodology_note: The initial re-sweep inherited the base script's packer_l1_acc=True compute kernel, which allows out_subblock_w up to 8; the model uses packer_l1_acc=False (cap 4). Re-swept with the model's real compute kernel and a 1D out-subblock cap of 4 -> the earlier lm_gate 1d_8x4_blk4_1x7 winner (osw=7) is INVALID in-model (TT_FATAL available_reg_count); the valid decode winner is 1d_8x4_blk4_1x1.
device_time_source: tracy DEVICE KERNEL DURATION [ns], min over 3 measured iterations (parse_tracy_generic.py --kind matmul_progcfg_lm).

lm_gate_prefill.note: AUTO OPTIMAL; all 2D formula configs 137k-196k ns (far slower); DRAM-sharded requires M==1 (decode only).

lm_qproj_decode.guard: M==1 (decode); q_proj across all attention layers
lm_qproj_decode.reason: 1.75x op-level, valid + safe (decode M fixed at 1), PCC identical, all tiers+demos green.

lm_gate_decode.guard: M==1 (decode); ONLY the dense-MLP gate out_features==6848 (layer 0)
lm_gate_decode.reason: 1.07x op-level, valid + safe, PCC identical. Marginal. MoE expert gates (896/1792) were NOT swept and keep AUTO.

lm_qproj_prefill.reason: op-level 1.43x is real but in-model negligible (LM prefill matmuls are a tiny fraction of the vision-dominated ~10.6s prefill) AND a fixed prefill config is only valid for a bounded M range (2D per_core_M covers Mt<=16 -> ~M<=512) so it needs a fragile shape guard. Left on AUTO.

lm_gate_prefill.reason: AUTO is optimal at the real prefill shape.

in_model_effect.note: Decode is trace/host-bound. Applied decode kernel savings (~104us/token q_proj across 12 layers + ~2us/token gate on layer 0) are ~0.2% of the decode period and do NOT measurably move the wall. Configs are numerically inert, valid, safe, and green; kept per the apply-if-valid-and-faster mandate, but the honest wall impact is ~flat.
